Last checkedSep 25, 2026 · 19:58 UTC-04:00
Coverage noteThe dealer roster was expanded from eight to 42 verified in-range Ford locations using dealer websites, regional directories and consistent routed driving distances. This snapshot displays 286 unique 2023-2026 VINs from 39 selling dealerships, including Ford Ile-Perrot; 214 vehicles were added and 1 prior listing was removed after HTTP 404. 267 displayed vehicles have verified VIN-specific factory stickers. Official decoding became access-limited during the scan; failed requests and retained earlier verification timestamps are identified in each vehicle's evidence. Shared dealer stock is deduplicated and conflicting offers retained. Used prices assume no government rebates. The existing $5,000 new-candidate near-miss band remains in effect; previously tracked live vehicles above it are retained. Coverage is not a complete regional census: Saint-Norbert pricing, two ambiguous directory branches, VIN-less orders and other unverified records remain unresolved. Distances use the same public reference throughout and can vary by route; final location, prices, taxes and rebates require a buyer order.

  • Driving-distance attribution — attribution: Routing data: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Driving routes calculated with OSRM. Distances are estimates for one consistently applied route profile.
  • Inventory identity and price limitations — partial: 413 unique VINs were identified in normalized offers; 125 new-candidate offers were outside the retained price band. 16 source records and 2 staged candidates were not publishable due to identity, source-link, price or evidence issues.   • NHTSA vPIC — partial: 93 requests completed before subsequent requests returned HTTP 403. Earlier verified immutable decoding is retained at its original timestamp where available; otherwise decode status is explicitly error. VIN-specific dealer/sticker evidence remains separate. Decoder contradictions and blank fields are not interpreted as confirmed equipment.
  • FordDirect Canadian window stickers — partial: 267 displayed vehicles have verified factory evidence. Placeholder or unavailable PDFs never establish option presence/absence. Factory documents describe the original build, not used condition, accessory supply or active service plans.
  • Cross-province new-vehicle rebates — verified: A Quebec resident may purchase a qualifying new vehicle elsewhere in Canada if first registration is in Quebec and other conditions hold. Ontario dealer prices here use estimated Quebec GST/QST and conditional Quebec registration assumptions, not Ontario HST quotations. Ontario demos without proven first-registration eligibility are excluded.
  • Government rebate rules — verified: Federal EVAP applies to eligible new vehicles, not used vehicles. Qualifying/near-miss groups use the existing conservative all-in transaction estimate; government benefits are deducted once after estimated tax. Specific vehicle and buyer eligibility must be confirmed.
  • Used Roulez vert conditions — verified: Used assistance requires a qualifying Quebec dealer purchase and verified model/year and prior-assistance history. No used provincial or federal benefit is assumed, including for Ontario listings.
Prices are CAD estimates from public listings. Qualifying new/demo, near-miss and used results are kept distinct. Used prices assume no government rebates. Unknown features and current equipment condition require verification. No dealer contact or purchase action is performed.
